## Part A — Creating Data Frames

```{r}
name <-  c("Ana", "Ben", "Cid", "Dex", "Eli")
age  <- c(20, 21, 19, 22, 20)
passed <-  c(TRUE, TRUE, FALSE, TRUE, FALSE)
students <- data.frame(
   name = name,
   age = age, 
   passed = passed
)
students
typeof(students$name)
class(students$name)
```

```{r}
courses <- data.frame(
  course_code = c("IS101", "IS102", "IS103"),
  units = c(3, 3, 2),
  instructor = c("Dr. P. Reyes", "Dr. R. Santos", "Dr. S. Cruz")
)
courses
```

## Part B — Subsetting Data Frames

```{r}
name <-  c("Ana", "Ben", "Cid", "Dex", "Eli")
age  <- c(20, 21, 19, 22, 20)
passed <-  c(TRUE, TRUE, FALSE, TRUE, FALSE)
students <- data.frame(
   name = name,
   age = age, 
   passed = passed
)
students$age
students[["age"]]
students["age"]
students[2, ]
students[3, "name"]
students[students$passed == TRUE, ]
students[students$passed == TRUE & students$age > 19, ]
```

## Part C — Data Frame Properties

```{r}
name <-  c("Ana", "Ben", "Cid", "Dex", "Eli")
age  <- c(20, 21, 19, 22, 20)
passed <-  c(TRUE, TRUE, FALSE, TRUE, FALSE)
students <- data.frame(
   name = name,
   age = age, 
   passed = passed
)
str(students)
dim(students)
nrow(students)
ncol(students)
colnames(students)
summary(students)
students
```

```{r}
name <-  c("Ana", "Ben", "Cid", "Dex", "Eli")
age  <- c(20, 21, 19, 22, 20)
passed <-  c(TRUE, TRUE, FALSE, TRUE, FALSE)
students <- data.frame(
   name = name,
   age = age, 
   passed = passed
)
students$year_level <- c(2, 3, 1, 4, 2)
students$passed <- NULL
students[order(students$age), ]
order(-students$age)
students
```
